lessons.introduction: Add an object to a Scene and observe its child count. This short experiment explores the scene structure before drawing shapes.

steps.title: Add an object to the scene
steps.explanation: A Scene holds objects. The starter displays the child count of an empty scene. Add one Object3D after creating the scene.
steps.solutionExplanation: scene.add(new Object3D()) attaches an object as a child of the scene. scene.children.length changes from 0 to 1. This experiment has no renderer and does not draw shapes.
steps.expected: The displayed number changes from 0 to 1.
hints: Pass a new Object3D to scene.add().
questions: What number would two added objects produce?

apis.description: Attaches an object as a child of this object. Scene inherits Object3D and uses the same method.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The object to attach as a child.

apis.result: Returns the object on which the method was called.
cautions: An object with an existing parent is removed from that parent first.
